Invique Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions

Invique Invite & Card Maker

Effective Date: August 9, 2026Last Updated: August 9, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Invique Invite & Card Maker (“Invique”, “the App”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) handles information when you use the application.

Your privacy is important to us. Invique is designed with a privacy-first approach. The App does not require an account and, based on its current functionality, does not collect, transmit, sell, rent, or share your personal information with us.

By using Invique, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

We do not collect personal data from users through the App.

Invique does not require you to create an account, provide your name, email address, phone number, address, or other personal information to us.

We do not intentionally collect:

  • Names or contact information

  • Email addresses

  • Phone numbers

  • Precise location information

  • Device identifiers

  • Advertising identifiers

  • IP addresses through our own systems

  • Usage profiles

  • Browsing history

  • Contacts

  • Payment information

  • User-created invitation content

  • Photos added to invitations

  • Recipient information

  • Analytics data through our own servers

The App is designed so that invitation and card creation can take place locally on your device.

2. User-Created Content

Invique allows users to create invitations, cards, designs, messages, and other content.

This content may include information entered by the user, including, for example:

  • Names

  • Event dates

  • Event locations

  • Messages

  • Contact information

  • Photographs or images

  • Information about invited persons

Such information is entered voluntarily by the user.

Invique does not upload this content to servers operated by us.

User-created projects and associated content are stored locally on the user's device unless the user independently chooses to export, share, copy, save, or otherwise transmit that content using features provided by the device or operating system.

You are responsible for ensuring that you have the necessary permission or lawful basis to use personal information, photographs, names, trademarks, copyrighted material, or other content belonging to third parties.

3. Local Device Storage

Projects, designs, preferences, and related application data may be stored locally on your device.

Because this information is stored locally:

  • We generally cannot access it.

  • We cannot restore it for you.

  • We cannot retrieve deleted projects.

  • We cannot guarantee recovery if the App is deleted.

  • We cannot guarantee recovery if your device is damaged, lost, reset, replaced, or experiences storage corruption.

Users are responsible for maintaining appropriate backups of content they consider important.

Some operating systems or device backup services may independently back up application data according to the settings configured by the user. Such services are controlled by their respective providers and not by Invique.

4. Photos and Media

If Invique allows you to select photos, images, or other media from your device, access is used only to provide the functionality requested by you.

Selected media may be incorporated into your invitation or card locally on your device.

We do not receive copies of those images on servers operated by us.

Access to photos or media is subject to the permission controls provided by your device operating system. You may modify or revoke these permissions through your device settings.

5. Sharing and Exporting Content

Invique may allow you to export or share invitations and cards.

When you choose to share content through messaging applications, social networks, email services, cloud storage services, AirDrop, or other third-party services, your content will be processed according to the privacy practices of the service you selected.

We do not control how third-party services process content after you voluntarily share or export it.

You should review the privacy policies of those third-party services before sharing sensitive or personal information.

6. Third-Party Services

The current version of Invique is designed not to transmit user-created invitation data to servers controlled by us.

However, your device, operating system, App Store provider, or services you voluntarily use for sharing or exporting content may independently process certain information.

Those services operate under their own terms and privacy policies, and their processing is outside our control.

If we introduce analytics, advertising, cloud storage, accounts, crash-reporting services, or other third-party technologies that materially change how information is handled, this Privacy Policy will be updated accordingly.

7. Advertising and Tracking

Invique does not use your invitation content for behavioral advertising.

We do not sell personal information.

We do not create advertising profiles from your invitation content.

We do not intentionally track users across applications or websites owned by other companies.

If this practice changes in a future version, this Privacy Policy and the applicable platform privacy disclosures will be updated.

8. Data Retention

Because user-created projects are stored locally on your device and are not stored on servers operated by us, we do not maintain a server-side retention period for such content.

You can generally delete locally stored content by:

  • Deleting the relevant project within the App, where available;

  • Clearing application data where supported by your operating system; or

  • Deleting the App from your device.

Some information may remain in device backups created independently by your operating system or cloud backup provider. We do not control those backups.

9. Children's Privacy

Invique is not designed to knowingly collect personal information from children.

Because we do not operate an account system or intentionally collect personal information through the App, we do not knowingly maintain personal information belonging to children on our servers.

Parents and guardians should supervise minors when creating or sharing invitations containing personal information.

10. Security

Invique is designed to minimize privacy risks by keeping user-created content on the user's device rather than transmitting it to servers operated by us.

However, no device, software system, or digital storage method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Users are responsible for maintaining appropriate device security, including passcodes, biometric authentication, operating system updates, and backups.

11. Your Privacy Choices

Because we do not maintain accounts or server-side databases containing your invitation projects, we ordinarily do not possess personal information that can be searched, exported, corrected, or deleted on your behalf.

You remain in control of locally stored content through your device and the App.

Where applicable law grants additional privacy rights, we will comply with valid requests to the extent that we actually possess or control information relating to the requesting individual.

12. International Users

Invique may be made available in multiple countries.

Privacy and consumer protection laws may vary depending on your location.

Nothing in this Privacy Policy is intended to limit any mandatory privacy right that cannot lawfully be waived or restricted under applicable law.

13. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect:

  • New App functionality;

  • Changes in applicable law;

  • New platform requirements;

  • Security improvements;

  • Changes in how data is processed.

When material changes are made, the “Last Updated” date at the top of this policy will be revised.

If a future version begins collecting or transmitting categories of personal information that are not described here, this Privacy Policy will be updated before or in connection with that functionality as required by applicable law.

14. Contact

If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or Invique's privacy practices, you may contact:

Email: contact form

By using Invique Invite & Card Maker, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

Questions about this document?

Send your request securely through the contact form.
